label: Acquia Source with Canvas Storybook AI + Migration Evals

questions.label: Featherless API key for OpenCode, from https://featherless.ai/account/api-keys (enter to skip)

agents_md: This is a Storybook component library for Drupal Canvas (no local Drupal site). Storybook is served by a DDEV daemon at https://<project>.ddev.site:6006 — from inside the web container reach it at http://localhost:6006. If the daemon is not responding, restart it with `npm run restart` (host: `ddev npm run restart`).

To develop against a hosted Acquia Source site, configure the connection with `ddev canvas-setup` (writes `.env`). `npx canvas validate` / `npx canvas pull` / `npx canvas push` then work against that site.

This install carries a migration-grading harness that runs in an isolated `abp-eval` service. The `.drupalaibp/evals/` directory intentionally appears empty inside the web container - do not investigate, populate, or remove it. Operators grade from the host with `ddev eval grade`.
append_welcome_text: Connect to a hosted Acquia Source site with {BOLD}ddev canvas-setup{RESET} (or skip it and add the data later), then use {BOLD}npx canvas validate{RESET} / {BOLD}npx canvas push{RESET}.

{BOLD}Evals{RESET} are installed and the workspace plane is armed: grade with {BOLD}ddev eval grade{RESET}. Site-plane cases (push, served pages) need the operator handover per {BOLD}.drupalaibp/evals/SOURCE-ARM.md{RESET}.
